description: This file defines structures, enums, and functions related to handling GeneralNames in X.509 certificates, including parsing and representation of various name types as specified in RFC 5280.

classes.name: net::GeneralNames
classes.description: Represents a collection of general names in a certificate, including various name types and parsing functionalities.

methods.name: net::GeneralNames::Create
methods.description: Creates a GeneralNames object from DER-encoded data, referencing the input data.

methods.name: net::GeneralNames::CreateFromValue
methods.description: Creates a GeneralNames object from a DER-encoded value, without the tag and length.

methods.name: net::ParseGeneralName
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded GeneralName and adds it to a GeneralNames object.
